svg.text: 1 Positive pulse: from the bond pad
along metal 2 to the PMOS drains
2 PMOS drain diode: P+ drain to N-well,
then up to the DVDD stripes over it
back to the DVSS bond pad
4 Clamp transistor, 4 blocks in parallel: from the
DVDD stripes to metal 2 of the DVSS pad
PAD net, bond pad and metal 2
